description: Reverse lookup of an international dialing code: which country (or countries, for shared codes like +1, +7 or +44) a code such as +36, 0036 or +1 876 belongs to, with capital, example number and the eFon rate page. Use this for "which country is +36", "who is calling me from +233", "what does 00252 mean" or a missed call from an unknown foreign number. Includes the cheapest eFon per-minute rate for calling back and a scam warning for one-ring calls; for the full rate list use get_call_rates.

code.description: Dialing code or the start of an international number: '+36', '0036', '36', '+1 876', '00252 61 123 4567'.

language.description: Language for country names and the returned page links.

name: lookup_calling_code
title: Which country is this calling code?
